question: Zymo correction benchmark
article_evidence: DeChat Table 5 evaluates one real-meta-Zymo dataset at approximately 30x average coverage and compares DeChat, VeChat, LoRMA, Herro, CONSENT, Canu, Racon, hifiasm, Daccord, and Raw
local_directory_evidence: Local main benchmark compares DADEC, FMLRC, LoRDEC, Ratatosk, CoLoRMap, proovread, and three HERO refinements on long_reads_10.fa
assessment: Not a file-level reproduction of DeChat Table 5

question: Five coverage settings
article_evidence: DeChat varying-coverage experiment uses simulated diploid E. coli at 10x, 20x, 30x, 40x, and 50x per haplotype
local_directory_evidence: Local coverage_self uses labels 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 with DADEC, DeChat, and VeChat on Zymo
assessment: Separate experiment with different dataset, labels, and compared methods

question: Meaning of local numeric labels
article_evidence: No article support that Zymo was evaluated at 5x-40x in these files
local_directory_evidence: long_reads_10.fa has 348551 of 3491390 full-set reads; scripts reference long_reads_5/10/20/30/40.fa
assessment: Labels are best interpreted as 5%-40% subsamples, not literal x coverage

question: Taxonomic classification
article_evidence: DeChat paper reports classification on sim-meta-low and sim-meta-high, not on real-meta-Zymo
local_directory_evidence: No Centrifuge, Kraken, MetaMaps, classification, taxonomy, precision, recall, or F1 result files found
assessment: Classification results are absent from this directory

question: Error categories
article_evidence: DeChat Table 5 separates mismatch, non-homopolymer insertion/deletion, and homopolymer insertion/deletion
local_directory_evidence: Local QUAST reports contain only mismatches per 100 kbp and aggregate indels per 100 kbp
assessment: Fine-grained Table 5 error categories cannot be recovered from these files
